object.DateText: ca. 380-250 BCE (Late Period (30th dynasty)-early Ptolemaic Period)
object.Title: Statue of a Crocodile with the Head of a Falcon
object.Description:
This may represent the god Horus the Elder, who is occasionally shown with a falcon head and a crocodile body, or a combination of the crocodile-god Sobek with the sun-god Re. A crowning element once completed the work.

For the latest information about this object, Statue of a Crocodile with the Head of a Falcon, visit the Online Collection of the Walters Art Museum.
object.Provenance: Dikran Kelekian, New York and Paris [date and mode of acquisition unknown]; Henry Walters, Baltimore, 1924, by purchase; Walters Art Museum, 1931, by bequest.
object.MuseumLocation: To learn whether this object is now on view, and in which gallery, visit https://purl.thewalters.org/art/22.347
